Use case: stylized-concept.

Reference images: Image 1 is the strongest style reference: match its simplified crooked cartoon buildings, thick simple pixel-stepped outlines and large perfectly flat solid color areas; remove all UI, characters and text. Image 2 is the original arena for muted gray architectural subject matter only, discard its texture and spatial layout. Image 3 is the original hero and purple filing-cabinet actor sheet for chunky cartoon proportions only; do not include actors.
Style: FLAT PIXEL CARTOON stage scenery, deliberately simple like the background in image 3. Chunky visibly stepped raster edges, crooked handmade silhouettes, only two solid shades per material. No black outlines; outlines are muted mid-gray only a little darker than their fill. Background must be substantially paler and quieter than black-outlined foreground actors.
Composition: straight-on side-view stage, no vanishing-point tunnel. Simplified architecture is attached to the rear wall. CRITICAL LAYOUT: back wall covers the top THREE QUARTERS of the canvas. Wall-floor seam exactly at y=75%, NOT near the middle. All furniture and door bases rest on y=75%. Bottom 25% is a single uninterrupted plain flat pale floor color. Keep left 10–32%, right 68–90%, and center 37–63% uncluttered and low contrast, for characters and a center board added later. Keep props peripheral or in rear wall, no foreground props. No actual board.
Color palette: pale muted warm grays, gray-mauve, dusty olive accent; small tonal differences.
Materials: large perfectly uniform opaque color blocks only, no surface texture at all, flat ambient illumination. Unshaded flat digital pixel drawing. Walls have at most two large simple flat shapes; floors have NO cracks, stains or scratches. Thick deliberately crooked stepped lines simplified like a children's cartoon pixel game.
